name: SFDC: View Opportunity Details (Known DID)
description: View complete Salesforce opportunity details for a known DID (Deal ID = Opportunity ID). DOES NOT search or look up DIDs — requires a specific DID/opportunity ID as input. Shows fields like Opportunity Name, Stage, Owner, Notes, Close Date, etc. Only use when you already have the DID.

steps.description: Navigate to Salesforce Classic (expects logged-in session)
Wait for search input field to appear
Enter DID parameter into search box
steps.param_description: DID number = the unique Salesforce Opportunity ID

steps.description: Wait for search results to load
Click opportunity record link in search results
Wait for opportunity details page to load

outputs.name: opportunity_details
outputs.label: Opportunity Details
outputs.parse_instructions: Extract all opportunity fields from the Salesforce Classic detail page. The deal_id/DID is the opportunity being viewed — NOT any DID mentioned in the opportunity notes text. Look for 'Important Opportunity Information' section for main fields like Account Name, Stage, Close Date, Opportunity Owner. The 'Products & Services' section contains TCV/ACV/ATR amounts. The 'Oppty Notes/Next Steps' section near the bottom contains all dated notes — extract the COMPLETE text without truncation.

fields.name: deal_id
fields.description: The numeric DID (Deal ID) that was searched for — same as input parameter, NOT any DID mentioned in opportunity notes

fields.name: account_name
fields.description: Account Name — the customer account for this opportunity

fields.name: opportunity_name
fields.description: Opportunity Name — the full name/title of the deal

fields.name: opportunity_owner
fields.description: Opportunity Owner — the Cisco sales rep or account manager responsible

fields.name: close_date
fields.description: Close Date — expected close/contract end date

fields.name: prior_contract_expiration_date
fields.description: Prior Contract Expiration Date — when the previous contract expires

fields.name: opportunity_notes
fields.description: Oppty Notes/Next Steps — ALL dated notes from the opportunity record (full text of all dated entries, do NOT truncate)

fields.name: forecasting_position
fields.description: Forecasting Position — position in sales forecast

fields.name: renewal_quarter_due
fields.description: Renewal Quarter Due — when renewal is forecasted (e.g. Q1-FY27)

fields.name: be_group
fields.description: BE Group — business entity groups involved

fields.name: renewal_opp_sav
fields.description: Renewal Opp SAV — SAV number for renewal opportunity

fields.name: service_amount_tcv
fields.description: Service Amount (TCV) — service total contract value in $000s

fields.name: service_amount_acv
fields.description: Service Amount (ACV) — service annual contract value in $000s

fields.name: service_atr
fields.description: Service ATR — service annual total revenue in $000s

fields.name: expected_services_attrition
fields.description: Expected Services Attrition — expected service dollar attrition in $000s

fields.name: opportunity_team
fields.description: Opportunity Team — list of team members (e.g. Account Manager, Renewal Manager, Renewal Specialist) with their roles
